PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Stores a single authenticated player's ChibiMon 200 progression, preferences, and per-level records.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the player.

email.description: Verified Google account email address (PII, owner-only).

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google profile.

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest level unlocked by the player (1 to 200).

totalScore.description: Cumulative best score across all completed levels.

soundEnabled.description: Whether Web Audio sound effects are enabled.

levels.description: Map of level numbers ('1'..'200') to LevelProgress objects containing completed, stars, bestScore, and bestTimeRemaining.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private player progression document owned strictly by the matching Firebase Auth user.
